trickyParts: Rig check 14 step 2's barrier subscribes to agentStreamControlSubject(S) with a bare NATS client (Services.nextControl) and waits for the relay's first watch plus 1 s; without it the RPC change can land before the first watch and be read while nobody watches.
Step 3 relaunches with `--resume <file> --model <other>`, so the resumed process holds settings no one has seen; only publishState on arming gets them to the held page.
keyboard-session-pickers.e2e.ts is self-contained (imports only ./agents, ./api, ./seed, ./users helpers present at the base) so the A5 baseline fails each row on its own assertion.
deviations: Finding 3 is fixed in the script, not only in the README: the script takes the keys out of its environment before it starts anything, and the driver takes them off process.env at once and passes them to Oh My Pi alone (Chromium, launched by Playwright, inherits process.env). The README now states that, and that a key is needed only for a model of its provider.
The SessionSettings test move adds one test the page file did not have: a held picker's step gives way to a new value the session reports for that picker (decision 8's reset clause).
The pi-envoy prepack test still fails in this pod only: its checkout holds bin/dispatch at 0775 (the volume's group-write umask); git records 100755 and CI packs 0755.
